fusions.name: Drink the Softened
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up. You drink from it, which deals 8 damage and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Tenderise
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Raid the Larder
fusions.desc: Feeds from every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Hung for Later
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
